name: Mohawks
description: The Mohawks were a street gang based on Mohawk Street in Chicago's Near North Side, formed in the early 1960s by cousins and nephews of the original Little Hell Sharks after Italian families were displaced from the Little Hell neighborhood by the expansion of the Cabrini Green housing projects. Along with the Hudsons and the Cleveland Jammers, the Mohawks united in the early 1970s to form the CORP gang, with the Mohawks considered the older, more experienced faction of the three.
